title: Architecting Early Fault Tolerant Neutral Atoms Systems with Quantum Advantage
abstract_summary: Proposes teleportation-based schemes for early fault-tolerant neutral atom systems targeting quantum dynamics simulations. Achieves ~3x speedup via reconfigurable connectivity parallelization. Demonstrates feasibility with ~11,495 atoms and ~15 hour runtime.
relevance_reason: Neutral atom fault-tolerant architecture for quantum dynamics — our holographic transport protocol is a quantum dynamics simulation. The 11k atom estimate for fault-tolerant dynamics sets the scale for our eventual full-fault-tolerant run.
connection_to_project: Provides hardware resource estimates for fault-tolerant quantum dynamics on neutral atoms (QuEra/Pasqal-class). Our transport protocol is a quantum dynamics simulation — this paper's estimates bracket what future fault-tolerant MERA transport would cost.
